title: UK man jailed for online blackmail of vulnerable girls around the world
summary_full: Beau-Jack Mensforth, 20, part of a group known as the Com, coerced girls into self-harm, making indecent images of themselves and physically harming petsThe Com: the global cybercrime network posing a ‘chilling threat’ to childrenA 20-year-old man from north-east England has been jailed for blackmailing vulnerable girls around the world, prompting a senior police officer to urge parents to regularly check their children’s devices.Beau-Jack Mensforth admitted 17 offences of making and distributing indecent photographs of children, blackmail, and participating in the activities of an organised crime group.
